data.long_meaning: Nridesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nr' which means 'Lord' and 'is' which means 'of the universe'. This name represents the supreme power and is revered in Hinduism. The name is also associated with the deity Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe. The name Nridesh carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nridesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
